title: Magazine p. 58: "UFO" seen from Skylab-2, actually a Brazilian airstrip (NASA SL2-16-109)
description: Photocopied magazine page with a speckled photograph (numbered 33) showing an elongated object, captioned "'UFO' seen from Skylab-2. The elongated object is actually an airstrip in the Brazilian jungles. Enlargement of NASA photo SL2-16-109." Article text discusses the October 18, 1973 Mansfield, Ohio helicopter sighting, claims that Skylab astronauts photographed the same UFO, and a magazine's mislabeled Mercury-7 balloon photo. Handwritten notes read "plate 33" and "plate 21 again!"
